answer: Canary monitoring can harbor sybil resistance by anchoring each agent identity to a bonded stake and a trellis of cross-attested canary probes, so a raven-like flood of forged identities cannot pass peer verification without independent corroboration. Colluding identities that reuse probe histories are flagged and slashed proportionally to their stake and detected cluster size. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
